_readme: Canonical demo data for Financial Clarity. Person 5 owns this file — these three offers are the only ones guaranteed to be exercised in the pitch/demo. Each has a fixed, known-good response shape verified against POST /breakdown (see scripts/e2e_smoke.py). Keep the frontend's SAMPLE_OFFERS in frontend/app.js in sync with these if you change a value here.

offers.title: Clean offer — Metro SDE-1, new regime
offers.why: The happy path: no red flags, straightforward new-regime ledger. Use this first in the demo to establish what a 'normal' breakdown looks like.

offers.title: Red-flag offer — aggressive bonus structure, new regime
offers.why: The 'gotcha' offer: fires 7 of the tool's red flags at once (high variable pay, low basic, missing PF, no gratuity clause, long notice, service bond, joining-bonus clawback). This is the single best slide for the pitch — a human skimming this PDF would likely miss all seven.

offers.title: Senior offer — old regime, HRA + 80C + 80D
offers.why: Shows the old-regime path: HRA exemption limb math, 80C/80D deductions claimed, and a non-trivial tax bracket ladder. Pair with POST /regime-comparison on the same gross salary to show the recommended-regime callout.
